for r in a:
 assert set(['card_id','letters','marks','crop_ok','errors','detail','owner_crop','where'])<=r.keys()

 assert len(r['owner_crop'])==5 and all(v in ['yes','no','uncertain'] for v in r['owner_crop'].values())
